elements.text: A factory reset erases all settings, ride history, saved routes, and the display PIN. Use it only when a bike is being scrapped or when Atlas support asks for it.
When the owner's PIN is unavailable, an authorized dealer must check the owner's proof of purchase and set a new PIN with the dealer service tool. Saved routes and ride history are kept.
Service the T-7 every 2,000 km or every 12 months, whichever comes first. Each service includes a brake check, a chain check, and a battery health test.
Run the battery health test from the dealer service tool. A battery below 70 percent of its original capacity can be replaced under warranty if the warranty is still valid.
